Susa izibuko zelanga nanoma yini enye evala ubuso bakho ngaphambi kokusetha.
Ukubheka ifoni yakho kungase kuyivule. Umuntu ofana nawe kakhulu angakwazi futhi ukuyivula.
Gcina amehlo akho evulekile futhi ubheke isikrini ngenkathi uvula.
Ukuvula ngobuso kungase kungavikeleki kancane kunephinikhodi eqinile, iphethini, noma iphasiwedi.
Idatha yobuso bakho igcinwe ngokuvikelekile kule divayisi futhi ayilayishwa.
Ungasusa idatha yobuso bakho noma kunini kokuthi Izilungiselelo.
